'''''Star Wars: On the Front Lines''''' is a [[canon]] reference book chronicling the many battles of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[The galaxy|galaxy]]. It was written by [[Daniel Wallace]], produced by [[becker&mayer!]], and published by [[Titan Books]] on [[August 8]], [[2017]].

==Publisher's summary==
''From the Clone Wars and the Rebellion to the clashes with the First Order, the galaxy is defined by war. ''Star Wars: On the Front Lines'' chronicles the tactics, weapons, and armor used in pivotal battles along with profiling acts of valor. By focusing on elements of the battles that occurred "off screen," this collection brings the struggles faced by ground soldiers and starfighter pilots to life like never before and places the reader on the battle lines.''<ref name="Becker Catalog" />

==Development==
It comprises 128 pages, and was originally slated for publication in the fall of [[2016]] by [[becker&mayer!]].<ref name="Becker Catalog">{{BeckerMayer|url=downloads/bm_2015AutumnSupplement.pdf|text=2015 Autumn Catalog Supplement}} Note: The catalog is for titles published in 2016, "2015 Autumn Catalog Supplement" is in error.</ref> As of [[September 8]], 2016, Wallace was still writing pieces for the book, and guessed that it would not be released before late [[2017]] at the earliest.<ref name="Twit">{{Twitter|danwall88|status/773642961901019136|[[Daniel Wallace]]|quote=I'm still writing pieces so I'd guess late '17 at the earliest}}</ref>

==Continuity==
*Page 57 incorrectly states that [[V-19 Torrent starfighter]]s were deployed late into the [[Clone Wars]], even though they had been around since [[22 BBY]], the first year of the conflict.<ref name="TCWfilm">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>
*The [[Battle of Jakku]] section states that [[Grand Moff]] [[Randd]] commanded [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] forces from the ''[[Acidity]]'', contradicting ''[[Aftermath: Empire's End]]'', which states that Randd commanded Imperial forces from the [[Super Star Destroyer]] ''[[Ravager]]''.<ref name="Empire's End">''[[Aftermath: Empire's End]]''</ref>
*[[Clone Commander]] [[Ponds]] is re-designated as "CC-6454."
*The book states the [[Battle of Starkiller Base]] takes place 30 [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Yavin]]. The battle actually takes place 34 years after the Battle of [[Yavin Prime|Yavin]].<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref>
*The book states that rather than becoming a part of the [[Imperial Navy]], [[Jan Dodonna]] retreated to his [[homeworld]] of [[Commenor]]. This contradicts ''[[A New Hope: The Princess, the Scoundrel, and the Farm Boy]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'', which both state that Dodonna served in the Imperial Navy.<ref name="ANH">''[[A New Hope: The Princess, the Scoundrel, and the Farm Boy]]''</ref><ref name="Rogue One UVG">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref>
